content.content: 1. Necessity per prerequisite: the refusal status needs each refusal outcome it codes — without any trigger, coding it is motiveless. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: status 2 contradicts no shall-refuse wording; no prerequisite fixes any other status. Fail on any contradiction.
content.rationale: Exit status is the machine-readable refusal signal; the gate forces it to cover every refusal path.
